title: Chicken pan fried with soy cider honey sauce
originalTitle: Chicken pan fried with soy cider honey sauce
ingredients: Scored on one side cross cross
Tsp olive oil (small pan if just a little) just use olive oil for healthier one
instructions: Fry in tbsp butter and tsp olive oil (small pan if just a little) just use olive oil for healthier one
Tsp soy sauce, tsp apple cider vinegar, tsp honey
Can add ginger and chili flakes and sesame oil
notes: Original Doc Shorthand: Do chicken breast, scored on one side cross cross — Toss in flour — Fry in tbsp butter and tsp olive oil (small pan if just a little) just use olive oil for healthier one — Chuck in garlic fresh — Tsp soy sauce, tsp apple cider vinegar, tsp honey — Chives on top to garnish — Salt pepper as needed — Can add ginger and chili flakes and sesame oil
